title: Loyalty Commission Rate for Long-Standing Financed Sellers — In-Place Home Resale
content:
**Commission terms.** At a closing to a buyer on an In-Place Home Resale file the commission is the loyalty commission rate, being the package's commission rate less the loyalty reduction, percent of the gross sale price, raised to the package's minimum commission, rounded half up to the cent and charged on the closing date; no commission is charged on a package whose commission rate is 0.0. The lowest closing price of a listed home is worked at the same rate: its closing deductions are divided by one less the loyalty commission rate as a fraction.

**Loyalty reduction.** The loyalty reduction follows the seller's tenure on the Home-Site Lease and the home's financing: a seller whose lease began 120 or more whole calendar months ago and whose home carries an open Home Purchase Financing loan from Hearthstone Home Finance has 1.0 percentage point taken off; a seller whose lease began at least 36 but fewer than 120 whole calendar months ago and whose home carries such an open loan has 0.5 percentage point taken off; any other seller has none.

The seller's tenure is counted in whole calendar months from the move-in date on the seller's Home-Site Lease to the handling date, whatever term is running. An open loan is a Home Purchase Financing loan on the home in active or delinquent status.

| Tenure (whole months since move-in) | Open Home Purchase Financing loan on the home | Loyalty reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 120 or more | yes | 1.0 point |
| 36 to 119 | yes | 0.5 point |
| fewer than 36 | yes | none |
| any | no | none |

## Boundary of the tenure (handling dates hypothetical; move-in 10 May 2016, open loan)

| Handling date | Whole months | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 9 May 2026 | 119 | 0.5 point |
| 10 May 2026 | 120 | 1.0 point |

## Worked commission (hypothetical sale on the Full-Service Resale Brokerage Plus, package rate 6.5, minimum 4500.00)

Gross sale price 90000.00; tenure 48 whole months; open Home Purchase Financing loan. Loyalty commission rate 6.5 less 0.5, so 6.0 percent: 5400.00, above the 4500.00 minimum, so the commission is 5400.00. The same seller with no open loan pays at 6.5 percent: 5850.00.
